signal: Mechanical Orchard raised $24M Series A and is seeing strong demand for its gen-AI Imogen mainframe modernization platform

email.subject1: a signal play for Mechanical Orchard
email.body1:
Stacy, saw Mechanical Orchard's Imogen platform is pulling strong demand on the back of your $24M Series A.

Demand moving faster than the team usually means more enterprise accounts in play than reps can cover before they ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Mechanical Orchard off your hiring and tech-stack signals, accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Stacy, quick follow-up for Mechanical Orchard.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline jump faster than headcount can, especially with long enterprise modernization cycles. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Mechanical Orchard needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Stacy, last bit of proof for Mechanical Orchard.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Mechanical Orchard's reply rate likely compares to other Series-A startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Stacy, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything right after a raise, and the fundraise-to-hiring stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an enterprise motion? I will tailor it to Mechanical Orchard either way.
